color.note: Three themes from one building: Office (the sunlit top floor), Underground (the tunnels where the cluster runs) and Underground · Glow (same tunnels, cables lit).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: the office floor (sand) / the tunnel wall (dark earth).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles, panels, popovers, the composer — anything set on top of the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, logs, input fields, the sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between stones: dividers, card and table borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, secondary buttons); 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels on surface and surface-raised; large or non-essential text only.

tokens.name: ochre-100
tokens.usage: Ochre tint: selected rows, the active nav item, the user's own chat bubble.

tokens.name: ochre-400
tokens.usage: Sandy ochre, the Ukubi colour: primary button fill, brand blocks, the cover. Text on it is on-ochre.

tokens.name: ochre-700
tokens.usage: Ochre as text or icon: links, active tab labels, on surface, surface-raised and ochre-100.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ochre-400 fill.

tokens.name: palm-100
tokens.usage: Palm tint: success and 'running' backgrounds, plant-like quiet highlights.

tokens.name: palm-400
tokens.usage: Palm leaf green: decorative accents, healthy-state dots, the cover's plant block.

tokens.name: palm-700
tokens.usage: Palm as text or icon on surface, surface-raised and palm-100.

tokens.name: led-core
tokens.usage: The LED at rest: white end of the pulse. Only for 'an agent needs you' / 'look here'.

tokens.name: led-glow
tokens.usage: The LED lit: orange end of the pulse and its halo. Never for decoration or brand; one lit LED per screen.

tokens.name: on-led
tokens.usage: Text on a led-glow fill (a notification count).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, as text/icon on every surface; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Background behind a danger message.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, as text/icon on every surface (shares ochre-700's value); always with a word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / healthy, a patina teal (not green-vs-red), as text/icon on every surface; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-100
tokens.usage: Background behind a success message.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface (3:1+).

tokens.name: wire-agent
tokens.usage: Cable for agents and pods running AI: graph edges, legend dots, chart series.

tokens.name: wire-data
tokens.usage: Cable for databases (Pigsty / Postgres HA).

tokens.name: wire-app
tokens.usage: Cable for web apps (Dreamer, Wird, the vocabulary app, notes).

tokens.name: wire-network
tokens.usage: Cable for network, ingress and DNS.

tokens.name: wire-storage
tokens.usage: Cable for storage and backups.

tokens.name: wire-compute
tokens.usage: Cable for compute: Proxmox hosts, nodes, VMs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: a landing title, an empty state's headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent read your dream and found three recurring symbols.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense lists, secondary text, table cells.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group headers in sidebars and legends; never sentences.

styles.name: arabic-display
styles.usage: Verses and roots shown large in Wird. Generous line height leaves room for harakat.

styles.name: arabic-body
styles.usage: Arabic running text, set 5px larger than Latin body so both read at the same weight.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and status lines: pod counts, latency, replication lag.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Dense where you scan (tables, logs), airy where you read (chat).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items: list rows, button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (inputs, buttons), table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and chat-bubble padding; gap between chat messages.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; between major regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of a page, empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Stone, not pebbles: crisp corners, barely worn. No pills, no circles except avatars and status dots.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, checkboxes, status badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, chat bubbles, panels, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the outer frame of a whole app view; the largest radius in the system.

chamfer.note: The stone cut: a 45° clipped corner (clip-path) on the top-right of a few signature blocks.

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Primary button and the composer's send button.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Hero panels, the cover's blocks, the agent's 'needs you' card. Never on more than two blocks per screen.

shadow.note: Stone sits on the ground: borders first, shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the floating composer, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-led
tokens.usage: The halo of the lit LED, at the peak of its pulse.
